_phase_m0_note: Phase M0 skeleton. Activates pyright-lsp (A5) + claude-md-management (A2) + superpowers + feature-dev. learn-kit kept available but not in enabledPlugins by default. Reviewed quarterly per policies/ci-gates.md Review Cadence.
rationale: A5 (LSP integration) — symbol-first search via pyright-lsp avoids string-grep false positives in Python (per policies/ai-agent.md §3). A2 (Stop hook self-improvement) — claude-md-management drives the .claude/hooks/stop-claude-md-improver/ scaffold that proposes CLAUDE.md update diffs after each session. Meta plugins (superpowers, feature-dev) supply brainstorming / TDD / code-explorer / code-architect / code-reviewer subagents.
